```yaml
name: Codex Review - Notify Code Owner
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - labeled
jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm install -g bun
          bun install

      - name: Run preflight checks
        run: |
          bun run ci:preflight

      - name: Build donor package
        run: |
          turbo run build --filter=@asym/donor

      - name: Extract code owner from PR
        id: extract_owner
        run: |
          echo "CODE_OWNER=$(echo '${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}' | grep -oE 'feat\\(.*\\)' | cut -d'(' -f2 | cut -d')' -f1)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Notify code owner
        if: env.CODE_OWNER != ''
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const codeOwner = process.env.CODE_OWNER;
            const owner = codeOwner ? codeOwner.replace('ui', 'UI') : '';
            const prNumber = context.payload.pull_request.number;
            
            if (owner) {
              // Create comment on PR
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                issue_number: prNumber,
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                body: `@${owner} this PR introduces UI changes including:\n\n- Shared motion presets\n- Reduced-motion awareness\n- Consistent hover/tap scales\n- Faster list exits\n- Token-aligned PageShell\n\nPlease review these changes for alignment with your expertise.`
              });
            }
```
